_comment: Values that are NOT in an official CBAM file. Every entry carries status=assumption and is shown as such in the UI. build_refdata.py copies these into json/assumptions.json and records them in the manifest.

mmbtu_to_gj.citation: International Table British thermal unit: 1 Btu = 1055.056 J (IPCC 2006 Guidelines, Vol. 2, Ch. 1, energy unit conversions)
mmbtu_to_gj.why: Indian city-gas invoices bill energy in MMBtu on a gross (GCV) basis.

kcal_to_kj.why: Gas invoices state calorific value in kcal/SCM.

ncv_gcv_ratio_natural_gas.citation: IPCC 2006 Guidelines, Vol. 2 (Energy), Ch. 1, section 1.4.1.2: NCV of natural gas is about 10 % lower than GCV
ncv_gcv_ratio_natural_gas.why: CBAM emission factors are per TJ on an NCV basis; invoices give GCV-based energy.

gas_allocation_key.citation: EC Guidance No. 5d, Example 3, Table 4-12 (p. 53): one average specific gas consumption (3.5 GJ/t) for both product groups
gas_allocation_key.why: The factory has one gas meter for both production processes; gas is attributed in proportion to tonnes produced.

carbon_price_paid_eur_per_t.citation: Regulation (EU) 2023/956 Art. 9: deduction only for a carbon price effectively paid in the country of origin; none is claimed for the sample factory
carbon_price_paid_eur_per_t.why: No carbon price paid in India is claimed in the demo.

q4_2026_price_eur.citation: Q4 2026 price will be published on 4 Jan 2027 (EC price page); Q3 2026 price used as an estimate
q4_2026_price_eur.why: Q4 2026 imports need a price before it is published.

projection_price_eur.citation: Latest published quarterly price (Q3 2026, published 5 Oct 2026), held flat; user-adjustable
projection_price_eur.why: Weekly prices from 2027 are unknown; projections 2027-2034 use a flat, editable price.

fx_inr_per_eur.citation: ECB euro foreign exchange reference rate for INR, 9 Oct 2026 (https://www.ecb.europa.eu/stats/policy_and_exchange_rates/euro_reference_exchange_rates/html/index.en.html)
fx_inr_per_eur.why: Show buyer cost in rupees; user-editable.
